coordinate_system: Y-up, character forward is +Z, character right is +X

character.proportions: neutral adult-proportioned anatomical reference; do not infer exact body measurements from poster
character.mesh: single watertight skinned character mesh where practical

materials.muscle_highlights: red translucent overlay, separate mesh/material layer

rig.deform_quality: clean joint deformation at shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees

exercise.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercise.setup: Stand with feet around shoulder width, toes turned out slightly if comfortable, arms forward for balance.

keyframes.label: standing_start
keyframes.pose: stand tall with feet grounded; ribs stacked over pelvis; gaze forward.

keyframes.label: descent
keyframes.pose: send hips down and slightly back; bend knees in line with toes; keep heels grounded and torso controlled.

keyframes.label: bottom_controlled
keyframes.pose: reach a comfortable depth without heels lifting or lower back rounding; knees track with toes.

keyframes.label: rise
keyframes.pose: push through the whole foot; extend hips and knees together; keep knees tracking with toes.

keyframes.label: standing_return
keyframes.pose: stand tall without leaning backward; pause.

form_checks: knees track in the same direction as toes
exercise.safety_note: Use a comfortable depth and clear the surrounding area. Do not force extra depth or add load to match a reference image.
